Title: Oracle Service Delivery Manager
Description:
**About Centroid**
Centroid helps organizations modernize, operate, and support mission-critical business systems across Oracle and multi-cloud environments. We provide advisory, deployment, migration, integration, and managed services, with a focus on strong client service, dependable delivery, and career growth for our employees.
  
  
Travel: up to 10%
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
Centroid is seeking a Service Delivery Manager (SDM) to lead assigned Cloud Managed Services accounts. This role is responsible for client satisfaction, service quality, account health, financial performance, and responsible growth. The SDM serves as the primary service management contact for clients and works closely with technical teams, leadership, and internal stakeholders to keep delivery aligned with scope, service commitments, and client expectations.
  
  
This is a client-facing delivery leadership role, not a hands-on technical administration role. The ideal candidate is organized, accountable, comfortable working through matrixed global teams, and able to manage priorities, risks, escalations, and follow-through in a fast-paced managed services environment.
  
  
What We’re Looking For
  
  
Success in this role requires more than experience. We are looking for candidates who can share real examples that demonstrate the following traits:
  
  

* Flexibility: Adapts quickly when priorities, client needs, or delivery constraints change.
* Process-driven and organized: Uses structure, follow-up routines, and clear communication to keep work moving.
* Intrinsically motivated: Takes initiative, follows through, and looks for ways to improve outcomes.
* Interested in learning and growing: Is coachable, curious, and open to learning Centroid’s way of working.
* Accountable: Owns commitments, raises risks early, and closes the loop with clients and internal teams.

Key Responsibilities
  
  
Client Leadership and Account Health
  
  

* Lead the overall health of assigned Cloud Managed Services accounts, including client satisfaction, retention, service quality, profitability, and responsible growth.
* Run the regular client and internal cadence, including monthly reviews, QBRs, risk reviews, decision tracking, and follow-up actions.
* Communicate performance, risks, recommendations, and improvement opportunities clearly to client and Centroid leadership.

Service Delivery and Governance
  
  

* Oversee service delivery across assigned accounts, technologies, and global teams while staying within SOWs, SLAs, procedures, and Centroid standards.
* Set up practical account governance, including meeting cadence, reporting, escalation paths, roles, responsibilities, and decision processes.
* Coordinate with technical, service desk, security, consulting, vendor, and leadership teams to keep work moving and handoffs clear.

Service Operations, Transitions, and Escalations
  
  

* Lead coordination and client communication during incidents, escalations, outages, maintenance windows, production changes, and other high-priority situations.
* Keep ownership clear, drive the communication rhythm, confirm recovery, and make sure RCA and corrective actions are completed.
* Support transitions into Cloud Managed Services by confirming scope, SLAs, resources, access, documentation, knowledge transfer, monitoring, ticket routing, and readiness.

Financial Management
  
  

* Manage account financial health, including budget, revenue, margin, utilization, forecasting, billing readiness, and financial risk.
* Watch demand and scope, identify out-of-scope work early, and support change orders, renewals, profitability improvements, and account planning.

Resource Leadership
  
  

* Lead onshore and offshore delivery teams supporting 24x7 operations while partnering with technical managers who own direct people management.
* Plan for capacity, identify coverage or skill gaps, coordinate assignments, improve handoffs, and coach teams on communication, documentation, escalation, and follow-through.

Security, Compliance, and Operational Risk
  
  

* Ensure assigned accounts follow Centroid’s security, privacy, access-management, audit, data-handling, and compliance requirements.
* Track evidence and follow-up for access approvals, onboarding, offboarding, controls, audit requests, security findings, patching needs, and other risks.

Reporting, Continuous Improvement, and Growth
  
  

* Provide clear reporting on SLAs, ticket trends, incidents, changes, availability, risks, projects, utilization, financials, and improvement actions.
* Use service data to spot recurring issues, process gaps, automation opportunities, and practical service improvements.
* Partner with Sales, Consulting, solution architects, and leadership on renewals, proposals, service expansion, and opportunities that create client value.

Additional Expectations
  
  
This is a remote position with limited travel. The SDM must be able to support client escalations, global team coordination, maintenance windows, and time-sensitive issues across time zones.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* 10+ years of enterprise IT or technology services experience, including 3 to 5 years leading service delivery, client accounts, operations, projects, or matrixed teams.
* Experience managing multiple client accounts, SLA-based services, ITSM processes, governance, escalations, financials, utilization, scope, reporting, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders and manage customer-facing service-delivery work.
* Strong communication, facilitation, negotiation, conflict-resolution, organization, and prioritization skills.
* Ability to turn complex technical and operational information into clear business communication and action plans.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL Foundation or higher; PMP, Certified ScrumMaster, or another service or project management credential is helpful.
* Experience with a Managed Services Provider supporting 24x7 enterprise operations and Oracle application, database, integration, infrastructure, or engineered-system services.
* Working knowledge of OCI, Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, hybrid environments, monitoring, patching, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, security, and identity and access management.
* Familiarity with HaloPSA, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, OpenAir, or similar platforms, plus experience with executive reviews, renewals, and service-growth opportunities.

Why Join Centroid
  
  
At Centroid, you will work with experienced teams, support meaningful client outcomes, and grow your career in a collaborative Cloud Managed Services environment. This role offers the opportunity to lead important client relationships, strengthen delivery practices, and make a visible impact across clients and internal teams.

Description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title:**
Manager, IT Infrastructure Center of Excellence
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Director, Information Technology Infrastructure & Services Delivery
  
  
**Business Unit / Function:**
Pr ocurement & Business Support
  
  
**Department:**
Information Technology
  
  
**Why This Role Matters**
Lead infrastructure technical excellence through standards, solution design, and engineering across Maaden sites. Translate approved IT direction into reliable, scalable infrastructure and reusable capabilities. Enable IT Services Delivery to operate and support services effectively, while keeping day-to-day operations and enterprise strategy ownership with the accountable teams.
  
  
**What You Will Deliver**
Manage the infrastructure Center of Excellence for networks, systems, datacenters, and databases. Provide technical requirements, design assurance, engineering guidance and knowledge transfer, aligned with enterprise architecture and the Director’s approved priorities.
  
  
**Contract Strategy and Governance**
Develop infrastructure standards, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps within enterprise architecture principles. Define technical specifications and acceptance criteria for infrastructure solutions and sourcing. Govern technology selection, standard configurations, and lifecycle plans, including upgrades, refresh, and retirement. Assess emerging technologies for business fit, interoperability, capacity, and supportability. Recommend designs and exceptions through established architecture authorities; enterprise policy and strategy remain with the accountable leaders .
  
  
**Contract Administration and Compliance**
Maintain design documentation, configuration baselines, and engineering procedures. Govern and oversee infrastructure projects within delegated authority, coordinating with PMO and IT Services Delivery on scope, delivery plans, milestones, budgets, risks, dependencies, architecture and standards compliance, acceptance, and transition to operations. Review supplier deliverables against agreed specifications and standards. Coordinate design assurance, testing, and operational handover with IT Services Delivery, including support documentation and knowledge transfer. Verify that designs address integration, availability, capacity, recovery, and maintainability before transition. Document technical deviations and corrective actions and escalate non-compliance through the responsible governance and contract owners.
  
  
**Contractor Performance Management**
Assess suppliers’ technical deliverables and engineering quality against agreed requirements. Define and monitor infrastructure service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs) in coordination with IT Services Delivery and relevant stakeholders; review performance against agreed targets, report deviations and drive corrective actions and continual design improvement. Use recurring-problem evidence from IT Services Delivery to inform engineering improvements. Develop infrastructure automation and DevOps engineering practices with delivery teams to improve repeatability and reduce manual work. Coach technical staff, share reusable designs and strengthen internal engineering capability. Daily operations, service support, and operational supplier SLA management remain with IT Services Delivery
  
  
**Commercial and Cost Management**
Develop capacity and lifecycle recommendations using utilization, availability, and technology requirements. Evaluate infrastructure options for standardization, reuse, and cost efficiency. Provide technical input to procurement, project estimates, and purchase requisitions within assigned responsibility; escalate funding and commercial decisions to the authorized owners. Manage and oversee infrastructure contracts, particularly the Infrastructure & Service Delivery managed service provider contract, within delegated authority and in coordination with Procurement, Legal, IT Services Delivery and relevant stakeholders. Validate technical scope, deliverables and SLAs/KPIs; oversee contractual compliance, performance reviews, escalations, corrective actions, changes, renewals, and exit/transition planning. Contract approvals remain with authorized signatories, and day-to-day operational ownership remains with IT Services Delivery.
  
  
**Risk, HSE and Business Continuity**
Define infrastructure resilience, backup and recovery design requirements with business continuity, security, and delivery teams. Support disaster recovery planning and testing; review technical findings and track engineering improvements. Apply relevant site HSE requirements during infrastructure work and escalate risks. Backup operations, incident response, and service restoration remain with IT Services Delivery.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
Infrastructure designs meet agreed standards and business requirements; documented handovers enable effective support. Roadmaps address capacity, lifecycle, and resilience needs. Technical assurance findings are resolved, or formally escalated, recurring issues inform engineering improvements, and delivery teams can reuse documented designs and procedures. Performance targets are agreed through the established management process.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in computer science or computer engineering. ITIL Foundation and ISO 20000-1 service management certification (preferred)
  
  
**Experience**
8–10 years of experience in IT service management, infrastructure, and end-user services, with practical technical requirements, infrastructure project, and standards experience. Good understanding of ITIL and ISO 20000 service management frameworks.
  
  
**Skills That Matter**
Infrastructure planning and technical documentation; analytical diagnosis and problem solving; emerging technology assessment; continuous improvement; stakeholder collaboration and communication; planning and prioritization; people leadership and capability development. Translate operational needs into clear technical specifications and explain design recommendations to technical and management audiences

Title: VP, Head of Cloud Solutions
Description:
**JOB SUMMARY:**

We are seeking a senior technology leader to own CFSB's cloud strategy, platform engineering, and cloud operating model. Reporting to the [CIO/CTO], this role owns the multi-year cloud roadmap and leads the team that builds and runs the bank's cloud platform — the landing zones, automation, networking, and controls that every other technology team builds on.

This is a hands-on leadership role in a regulated environment. You should be equally comfortable presenting a cloud investment case to executive leadership, reviewing an infrastructure-as-code pull request with an engineer, and explaining to an examiner how cloud controls are designed and evidenced. We expect recommendations and tradeoffs, not problems to be assigned.

The role manages five to eight cloud engineers and partners closely with Information Security, Risk, Compliance, Enterprise Architecture, and the product squads. You are the accountable technology owner for how security and regulatory requirements are implemented and evidenced in the cloud. The team participates in a shared on-call rotation and provides after-hours support to the business; this role serves as its senior escalation point.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

***Cloud Strategy and Roadmap***

* Own and maintain the multi-year cloud strategy and migration roadmap, sequenced against business priorities, risk appetite, and budget cycles.
* Translate strategy into executive-ready business cases and committee-level materials, and secure funding and alignment for cloud investments.
* Set cloud target architecture and standards with Enterprise Architecture — reference patterns, approved services, and guardrails for what teams may build.
* Define and report program metrics — migration progress, platform reliability, control coverage, and unit cost trends — and advise leaders on build-versus-buy and cloud-versus-on-premises decisions.

***Platform and Infrastructure Engineering***

* Lead the design, build, and operation of the cloud platform: multi-account landing zones, identity and access, network architecture and hybrid connectivity, observability, backup, and resilience.
* Establish infrastructure-as-code and pipeline-based delivery as the default provisioning mechanism, and eliminate manual, undocumented change.
* Own the cloud CI/CD, container, and DevOps tooling that squads consume, and enforce engineering standards for code review, environment promotion, change management, and documentation.
* Ensure environments meet availability and recovery objectives; lead resilience testing and serve as senior escalation point for major incidents through to permanent corrective action.

***Cloud Security, Risk, and Regulatory Compliance***

* Own the implementation and evidencing of cloud technical controls that satisfy policies and standards set by Information Security, Risk, and Compliance, and escalate gaps where cloud reality and policy diverge.
* Serve as the cloud subject matter expert in internal audit, external audit, and regulatory examinations, including FFIEC and GLBA obligations, and produce control evidence and remediation plans.
* Embed guardrails as code — configuration baselines, encryption and key management, privileged access controls, and continuous compliance monitoring — and remediate findings and drift to agreed timelines.

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Description:
Atos is the Atos Group brand dedicated to AI-powered, secure, end-to-end digital services. Atos designs, develops, and operates critical digital environments that drive performance, resilience and sovereignty, helping public and private organizations worldwide retain control over their data and infrastructures, while meeting regulatory requirements.
  
  
With more than 52,000 employees serving over 4,500 clients across 54 countries, Atos helps modernize core IT systems, accelerate cloud and data transformation, strengthen cybersecurity, and deliver secure digital workplace environments to support its clients, its employees and society. Atos also provides consulting and advisory services through its Atos Amplify brand.
  
  
A trusted partner in operating complex and mission-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts.
  
  
**About Atos Group**
Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 54,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion, operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is listed on Euronext Paris.
  
  
Senior Director, Client Delivery & Operations
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
Atos is seeking a
**Senior Director, Client Delivery & Operations**
to lead the North American client delivery organization. Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, this executive will be accountable for the operational performance, service delivery execution, customer experience, and financial health of a large, multi-practice delivery organization supporting more than
**$1 billion in annual business**
and a workforce of more than
**1,000 delivery professionals**
.
  
  
This leader will oversee a broad and complex portfolio that includes managed infrastructure services, compute, data center, network, cloud, cybersecurity, applications, digital workplace, application management services, staff augmentation, project-based delivery, and long-term managed services. The role requires a leader who understands the operational and commercial differences between time-and-materials engagements, project delivery, and managed services, and who can establish a consistent delivery model across them.
  
  
The Senior Director will serve as the delivery organization’s primary service provider to Atos account and client leadership teams. While this individual will not directly own customer accounts, they will be accountable for ensuring that the services promised to customers are delivered effectively, consistently, and profitably. The role will work closely with account teams, practice leaders, and business-line executives to align delivery capabilities with customer requirements and business commitments.
  
  
This leader will establish common operating practices, strengthen collaboration across business lines, clarify ownership, and modernize delivery through automation, artificial intelligence, and innovative operating models.
  
  
Success will require significant experience leading large-scale technology delivery organizations, strong commercial and financial acumen, executive presence, and the ability to drive accountability across a complex matrixed environment. The successful candidate must be comfortable leading through organizational change and operational uncertainty, stabilizing customers in crisis, challenging legacy approaches, and making difficult decisions while maintaining the trust of customers, employees, and executive stakeholders.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Enterprise Client Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Own overall service delivery execution across the North American client delivery organization.
* Provide leadership across an organization of more than 1,000 delivery professionals supporting a business portfolio exceeding $1 billion annually.
* Ensure consistent achievement of contractual commitments, service-level agreements, operational targets, customer outcomes, quality standards, and financial objectives.
* Establish clear accountability for delivery performance across practices, business lines, and service portfolios.
* Create a culture of operational excellence, customer focus, transparency, urgency, and disciplined execution.
* Partner with practice leaders and account teams to identify and mitigate delivery risks before they affect customers.
* Serve as the senior executive escalation point for significant delivery, service, operational, and customer issues.
* Lead the stabilization and recovery of complex or distressed customer engagements, including situations involving service disruption, performance deterioration, delivery breakdowns, or customer dissatisfaction.
* Ensure delivery leaders maintain effective operational governance across both long-term customers and new or transitioning engagements.

Shared Delivery and Service Integration
  
  

* Lead an integrated delivery model encompassing staff augmentation, time-and-materials engagements, project-based delivery, and managed services.
* Align delivery across infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, digital workplace, applications, application management services, compute, data center, and network services.
* Ensure customers experience one coordinated Atos delivery organization, regardless of the technologies, business lines, or delivery teams involved.
* Establish standardized operating procedures governing service transitions, work transfers, escalations, ownership boundaries, resource deployment, and cross-practice collaboration.
* Eliminate operational silos and reduce delays, ownership confusion, inconsistent practices, and failed handoffs between service areas.
* Define clear roles and decision rights among practice operations, account leadership, client management, solution teams, and delivery organizations.
* Resolve organizational friction, competing priorities, and operational conflicts that impede customer delivery.
* Preserve the technical expertise of individual practices while aligning them around common customer and business outcomes.

Financial and Business Performance
  
  

* Own the financial and operational performance of the North American client delivery organization.
* Drive improvements in margin, productivity, utilization, scalability, delivery quality, and cost efficiency.
* Partner with practice leaders, account leaders, finance, workforce management, and portfolio owners to optimize staffing, capacity, location strategy, and workforce planning.
* Maintain an effective balance between customer commitments, service quality, employee capacity, and profitability.
* Identify structural cost, productivity, and delivery-model improvements that strengthen the performance of the existing book of business.
* Support revenue retention and growth by increasing customer confidence, improving service consistency, and strengthening delivery credibility.
* Establish performance metrics, operating reviews, executive dashboards, and corrective-action mechanisms that provide transparency across the organization.
* Hold leaders accountable for operational commitments, financial performance, risk mitigation, and sustainable improvement.

Customer Experience and Service Excellence
  
  

* Ensure delivery decisions are driven by customer impact rather than internal organizational boundaries.
* Improve customer satisfaction, service quality, responsiveness, reliability, and delivery consistency.
* Partner with account and client leadership teams to understand customer priorities and translate them into executable delivery plans.
* Provide delivery expertise and operational support to account teams without displacing their commercial ownership of the customer relationship.
* Improve the organization’s ability to anticipate customer concerns and resolve issues before they become executive escalations.
* Build strong relationships with senior customer stakeholders during critical delivery situations, service recoveries, and major transformations.
* Reinforce accountability for the entire customer outcome rather than individual service towers, practices, or contractual components.
* Use customer feedback, operational data, service trends, and root-cause analysis to drive measurable improvements.

Transformation, Automation, and AI
  
  

* Develop and execute a transformation roadmap for the North American delivery organization.
* Modernize legacy processes, governance structures, and delivery practices to improve speed, consistency, and accountability.
* Advance the use of AI, automation, analytics, and intelligent operations across service delivery.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, accelerate issue resolution, improve service predictability, and enhance the customer experience.
* Establish scalable operating models that support multiple service types, technologies, and customer environments.
* Promote greater use of standardized tools, processes, controls, and performance data.
* Lead the organization through a period of significant change while maintaining service continuity and customer confidence.
* Position the delivery organization to operate successfully in an increasingly AI-enabled technology services market.

Organizational and Practice Leadership
  
  

* Provide leadership and direction to practice and delivery leaders responsible for specialized service portfolios.
* Build a cohesive leadership team aligned around shared customer, operational, and financial objectives.
* Establish clear expectations and hold leaders accountable for results.
* Develop succession plans and strengthen the organization’s delivery, operational, and customer-leadership capabilities.
* Create an environment that rewards collaboration, transparency, responsible decision-making, and enterprise-wide thinking.
* Challenge internal behaviors and legacy structures that prioritize practice interests over customer outcomes.
* Communicate a clear transformation vision and translate that vision into measurable operating priorities.
* Bring energy, resilience, and visible leadership to a large organization navigating substantial operational and market change.

**Required Qualifications**

* Approximately 15 or more years of progressive leadership experience in technology services, client delivery, operations, managed services, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading a large, complex delivery organization, preferably involving more than 1,000 employees or delivery professionals.
* Significant experience overseeing an annual business portfolio, delivery organization, or P&L approaching or exceeding $1 billion.
* Experience operating across multiple technology domains, such as managed infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, digital workplace, applications, application management services, compute, data center, and network services.
* Proven understanding of staff augmentation, time-and-materials engagements, project-based delivery, and managed services operating models.
* A successful record of leading service transformation, organizational integration, operating-model redesign, or enterprise delivery modernization.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex customer escalations, distressed engagements, operational crises, and service-recovery programs.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including experience with margin improvement, utilization, workforce planning, productivity, cost management, and P&L performance.
* Experience leading through a matrixed organization in which delivery, practices, account teams, sales, finance, and customer leadership have interconnected responsibilities.
* Ability to understand a broad technology services portfolio sufficiently to make sound operational decisions and lead specialized practice executives.
* Executive-level communication, stakeholder-management, negotiation, and conflict-resolution capabilities.
* Willingness to challenge established practices, address performance issues, and make difficult decisions when customer or business outcomes are at risk.
* Demonstrated judgment, self-awareness, resilience, and leadership maturity.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, engineering, or a related discipline; an advanced degree is preferred.

Leadership Profile
  
  
The successful candidate will be
  
  

* Customer-centered Consistently prioritizes customer outcomes over internal structures and organizational boundaries.
* Operationally rigorous Establishes clear standards, measures performance, and maintains consistent accountability.
* Transformational Challenges legacy approaches and converts a broad modernization vision into executable change.
* Crisis-tested Remains composed and decisive during major customer, service, and organizational challenges.
* Commercially grounded Understands how delivery quality, cost, customer confidence, and profitability affect one another.
* Enterprise-minded Leads across the entire delivery organization rather than advocating for a single practice or technology tower.
* Influential Aligns senior stakeholders and specialized leaders without relying solely on organizational authority.
* Energetic and resilient Brings visible momentum to a large organization operating through significant change.
* Self-aware Understands their impact on others, listens to competing perspectives, and adjusts appropriately without compromising accountability.
* Decisive Makes timely, evidence-based decisions and accepts responsibility for outcomes.

Location and Travel
  
  
This position may be based anywhere in the United States, with the Irving, Texas area preferred. The role is expected to require occasional travel of up to approximately 25 percent
  
  
The base compensation range for this role is $250,000 – $300,000 USD.

Title: Network Operations Manager

**Position Summary**
The Network Operations Manager provides leadership in network operations, configuration management, and troubleshooting to ensure the delivery of high-quality services across all network-related functions. This role oversees the network operations team and is responsible for the performance, reliability, and support of the campus LAN/WAN environment. Responsibilities include supervising technical support staff, fostering their professional development, and ensuring effective training and team growth. In addition, this position manages network administration, software licensing management, and related research and development initiatives. The role collaborates closely with the Sr. Director of Information Technology by developing and recommending policies and strategies pertaining to network infrastructure and services. The ideal candidate is a collaborative and adaptable leader who brings strong problem-solving skills, creativity, and a commitment to continuous improvement. This position reports directly to the Sr. Director of Information Technology.
  
  
**POSITION DUTIES**
  
  

* Leadership & Management

+ Provide leadership, supervision, mentoring, and professional development for Network Operations and helpdesk staff.
+ Establish performance expectations, conduct evaluations, and support career growth for team members.
+ Recruit, hire, train, and retain highly qualified technical staff.
+ Foster a collaborative, customer-focused service culture across Information Technology.
+ Develop departmental goals, operational plans, and performance metrics aligned with University strategic objectives.

* Network Infrastructure & Operations

+ Lead the design, implementation, monitoring, and support of the University's enterprise network infrastructure.
+ Ensure reliable operation of wired, wireless, internet, VPN, cloud connectivity, telecommunications, and network security services.
+ Oversee lifecycle management of network hardware, software, and supporting technologies.
+ Maintain network architecture documentation, diagrams, standards, and operational procedures.
+ Manage network performance, capacity planning, and technology refresh initiatives.
+ Coordinate and support incident response activities related to outages, performance degradation, and infrastructure failures.

* Cybersecurity & Risk Management

+ Partner with Information Security leadership to maintain a secure technology environment.
+ Implement and maintain network security controls including firewalls, network segmentation, access controls, and monitoring systems.
+ Assist with vulnerability management, security assessments, remediation activities, and compliance initiatives.
+ Participate in cybersecurity incident response and disaster recovery planning.
+ Identify operational and technology risks and develop mitigation strategies.

* Systems, Cloud & Service Delivery

+ Support enterprise systems and infrastructure including Microsoft 365, Active Directory, identity and access management, virtualization platforms, and cloud-integrated services.
+ Oversee service desk escalation processes and support continuous improvement of IT service delivery.
+ Establish and monitor service level objectives (SLOs) and operational performance metrics.
+ Develop and maintain operational procedures, technical documentation, and knowledge resources.
+ Ensure business continuity, backup, and disaster recovery processes are maintained and tested.

* Project & Vendor Management

+ Co-lead infrastructure modernization projects and strategic technology initiatives.
+ Develop project plans, timelines, resource estimates, and implementation strategies.
+ Participate in managing technology vendors, service providers, maintenance agreements, and licensing.
+ Participate in budget development, forecasting, and technology purchasing decisions.
+ Evaluate emerging technologies and make recommendations for adoption.

* Collaboration & Communication

+ Partner with faculty, staff, and university leadership to understand business needs and deliver technology solutions.
+ Communicate operational status, project progress, risks, and recommendations to leadership.
+ Participate in institutional planning efforts and technology governance initiatives.
+ Promote effective collaboration across all IT functional areas.

* Other Duties

+ Participate in after-hours maintenance windows and provide support during critical incidents when necessary.
+ Perform other duties as assigned including participation in annual commencement ceremonies.

**Required**
**SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.
* Five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in network infrastructure, systems administration, or enterprise technology operations.
* Three (3) years of supervisory or team leadership experience. Ability to train, develop and encourage a staff of technicians.
* Experience supporting enterprise networking technologies, wireless infrastructure, routing, switching, firewalls, and network security. Experience with and good working knowledge of Domains, Segmentation, Account Management, Network backups, Trusts, Policies, Network Protocols, Bindings, Software Imaging, QoS.
* Experience with Microsoft technologies including Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Azure/Entra ID, Exchange, Teams, Sharepoint, M365 CoPilot, Windows Server environments.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and operational responsibilities simultaneously.
* Ability to work effectively and cooperate with staff, faculty, adjuncts, students and vendors.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Must be willing to work irregular hours when necessary and be on call for support of campus technology services.

**Preferred**

* Experience in higher education technology environments.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure and identity management platforms.
* Experience leading cybersecurity, disaster recovery, or infrastructure modernization initiatives.
* Industry certifications such as Microsoft Azure Network Engineer (AZ-700), CISSP, CWNP, Network+, Security+, ITIL, or equivalent.
* Experience with network monitoring, automation, and infrastructure management tools.
* Experience with HP Networking, Ruckus Wireless, Fortinet Firewalls, Hyper-V Server.

**SALARY**
This is an exempt, full-time, benefit-eligible position. Expected Salary Range: $95,000 - $97,500 (annual).

Description:

**Job Summary**
  
  
Full-time
  
Hybrid | Toronto, ON, Canada
  
This posting is for a newly created position
  
Salary range $130,000 - $145,000

Reporting to the Senior Manager, IT/OT Infrastructure and Cybersecurity, you will be part of a team developing advanced OT and energy solutions for large business and institutional customers, including electric vehicle charging, battery energy storage systems (BESS), solar PV, microgrids, and distributed energy resources. Your work will directly support the design, deployment, cybersecurity, operation, and lifecycle management of mission-critical operational technology infrastructure that enables the transition to a clean energy economy.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on OT infrastructure practitioner with deep networking expertise and strong practical capability across telecommunications, server infrastructure, cybersecurity implementation, commissioning, and technical documentation. You understand an OT environment end to end, from physical telecommunications and network topology through servers, applications, remote access, and security controls. You translate requirements from OT Cybersecurity, Systems Integration, Engineering, and Operations into reliable, secure, maintainable infrastructure.

This is not a cybersecurity governance or design-only role. You will move between architecture, implementation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and operational support, and own technical problems through to resolution, while helping establish scalable, secure-by-design OT standards across PowerON’s growing fleet electrification portfolio.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**OT Network & Infrastructure Architecture**

* Design, build, and support secure, scalable, and highly available OT network architectures for electrification infrastructure projects including EV charging depots, BESS, DERs, and microgrids.
* Own OT network topology, segmentation, VLANs, routing, switching, and network services.
* Set up and configure servers, virtualization, and supporting infrastructure for OT applications and services, including patching, lifecycle planning, backup configuration, and recoverability.
* Understand and map communication and data flows between server hosts and applications.
* Design and implement secure remote-access architecture.
* Develop network architectures supporting secure integration between OT systems, cloud platforms, enterprise IT systems, and third-party vendor environments.
* Implement resilient industrial network topologies including PRP, HSR, redundant ring architectures, and industrial failover strategies.
* Translate logical architecture into functioning, supportable infrastructure.
* Collaborate with systems integrators, software vendors, consultants, utilities, and engineers of record to ensure alignment between OT network architecture and overall project objectives.
* Evaluate and select OT infrastructure technologies including firewalls, switches, cellular gateways, servers, VPN/remote access technologies, and industrial communications equipment.

**Telecommunications & Site Connectivity**

* Understand and work with the physical network and telecommunications topology supporting operational sites and systems.
* Assess site connectivity and infrastructure dependencies, and how physical connectivity supports the logical OT network architecture.
* Plan for telecommunications requirements during deployment and commissioning.
* Troubleshoot connectivity across physical and logical layers to protect OT system availability and performance.

**OT Cybersecurity Implementation**

* Work with OT cybersecurity leadership to translate cybersecurity architecture and requirements into implemented technical controls.
* Implement network segmentation, security zones, firewall policies, access control rules, and data flow matrices.
* Implement secure remote access for employees, contractors, and vendors, including administration of VPN and privileged access management (PAM) solutions and identity and privileged-access controls for OT systems.
* Harden systems and apply secure configuration across OT infrastructure.
* Carry out patch and vulnerability remediation and implement backup and recovery controls.
* Apply secure-by-design principles aligned with ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, and Zero Trust.
* Contribute to cybersecurity risk assessments and technical reviews, and carry out the resulting remediation.

**Project Delivery, Commissioning & Technical Oversight**

* Support projects across the full lifecycle including requirements development, detailed design review, procurement support, FAT/SAT testing, commissioning, and operational turnover.
* Lead infrastructure commissioning and operational readiness, and support the transition from project delivery into operations.
* Own technical problems through to resolution: identify deficiencies, perform root-cause analysis, and establish a practical path to green.
* Coordinate remediation across SCADA, electrical, cybersecurity, and operations teams, and track technical issues through closure.
* Ensure final deliverables align with approved requirements, standards, and operational expectations.

**Operations & Lifecycle Support**

* Provide operational support for deployed OT infrastructure across active electrification sites.
* Support maintenance and lifecycle management of industrial firewalls, managed switches, OT servers, virtualization infrastructure, remote access platforms, and industrial communications devices.
* Support system uptime, reliability, and operational continuity through proactive monitoring, troubleshooting, and coordination with operations teams, contractors and vendors.
* Participate in on-site activities as required to support commissioning, troubleshooting, incident response, and operational support.

**Documentation & Standards**

* Create and maintain logical and physical network diagrams, infrastructure architecture, data-flow documentation, and as-built documentation that accurately reflect the implemented OT environment.
* Maintain operational OT network documentation including IP address schemas, AD roles and permissions, firewall rule matrices, VLAN segmentation documentation, and remote access inventories.
* Develop network and infrastructure requirements and technical design documentation issued to vendors, contractors, and engineering consultants.
* Establish configuration and implementation standards that scale across PowerON’s portfolio.
* Treat documentation as part of engineering delivery, not an afterthought.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* University degree in Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience supporting OT networks, industrial infrastructure, SCADA systems, or critical infrastructure environments.
* Deep, hands-on expertise in OT network topology, VLANs, routing and switching, NAT, VPN technologies, firewall policy management, network segmentation, and redundant network architectures.
* Hands-on experience setting up, configuring, patching, and backing up server and virtualization infrastructure in OT environments, including Windows Server.
* Strong working knowledge of physical telecommunications infrastructure and site connectivity, and how they affect OT system availability and performance.
* Experience implementing security controls on industrial networking and security technologies such as Fortinet, Palo Alto, Cisco Industrial Ethernet, and RuggedCom, including system hardening and vulnerability remediation.
* Familiarity with industrial protocols including Modbus TCP/IP, DNP3, IEC 61850, OPC UA, MQTT, and SCADA/EMS systems.
* Familiarity with ISA/IEC 62443 and NIST SP 800-82.
* Experience supporting cloud-connected OT architectures and hybrid IT/OT environments.
* Demonstrated experience commissioning infrastructure, resolving deficiencies, and transitioning projects into operations.
* Experience producing and maintaining as-built documentation, network drawings, and data-flow documentation, and reviewing vendor deliverables.
* Strong troubleshooting and structured problem-solving skills, with a track record of driving issues to resolution, not just identifying them.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical risk and remediation paths to engineering, cybersecurity, and operations teams, vendors, and partners.

The Cloud Service Delivery Manager is responsible for overseeing the delivery, reliability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement of enterprise cloud services across public, private, and hybrid cloud environments. This role serves as the primary liaison between Cloud Operations, Engineering, Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders to ensure cloud platforms meet service level objectives, operational standards, compliance requirements, and business expectations.
  
  
The successful candidate will drive operational governance, incident and problem management, service performance, capacity planning, financial optimization, vendor management, and continuous service improvement while fostering a culture of accountability, automation, resiliency, and customer focus.

Service Delivery & Operations Management
  
  

* Own end-to-end delivery and operational performance of cloud infrastructure and platform services.
* Ensure services meet or exceed defined SLAs, SLOs, availability targets, and customer expectations.
* Lead operational governance reviews and service performance reporting with senior leadership.
* Monitor service health, capacity, utilization, and operational risks across cloud environments.
* Establish and maintain operational runbooks, service documentation, and support processes.

Operational Excellence
  
  

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on stability, automation, resiliency, and operational efficiency.
* Lead root cause analysis efforts and ensure corrective actions are implemented for major incidents.
* Develop and track key operational metrics and KPIs.
* Champion Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and DevOps practices to improve platform reliability.
* Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt and improve service quality.

Incident, Problem & Change Management
  
  

* Serve as the escalation point for major incidents and service disruptions.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams during critical issue resolution activities.
* Lead problem management processes to identify recurring issues and implement permanent fixes.
* Ensure effective change management practices minimize operational risk and service disruption.
* Facilitate post-incident reviews and executive communications.

Stakeholder & Relationship Management
  
  

* Act as the primary interface between Cloud Operations and internal business stakeholders.
* Build strong partnerships with Engineering, Security, Architecture, Risk, Compliance, and Application teams.
* Present service performance, risk assessments, and improvement plans to executive leadership.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure alignment between service delivery and business objectives.

Cloud Governance & Compliance
  
  

* Ensure cloud services operate in accordance with enterprise governance, security, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
* Support audit activities and risk management initiatives.
* Monitor operational controls and remediation activities.
* Drive adherence to cloud operational standards, policies, and best practices.

Financial & Vendor Management
  
  

* Partner with cloud engineering and finance teams to optimize cloud operating costs.
* Monitor cloud consumption trends and support chargeback/showback initiatives.
* Manage relationships with cloud service providers and strategic vendors.
* Participate in contract reviews, service evaluations, and vendor performance assessments.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead and mentor cloud operations personnel and service management teams.
* Foster a customer-centric culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Support workforce planning, talent development, and succession planning.

* 3+ years of leadership experience managing cloud operations, service delivery, or infrastructure teams.
* Strong knowledge of public cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, AWS, and/or Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience managing enterprise-scale cloud environments in highly regulated organizations.

Title: Technical Program Manager-Data Center
Description:
**About the Role:**

The Technical Program Manager administers the qualification and validation of new products, and of retrofits and engineering changes to existing parts, for use in large-scale data center environments. The program spans inside plant (ISP) and outside plant (OSP) optical fiber cable, connectivity, and pathway products from candidate identification through validated, released configuration. The position owns the technical content of the program: product selection and evaluation criteria, test methodology, acceptance limits, measurement integrity, and the qualification record that supports product approval and release. The Technical Program Manager serves as the technical interface between design engineering, construction and installation crews, component manufacturers, and test equipment suppliers, and is accountable for validated, documented, and field-reproducible connectivity products on schedule.

**What You’ll Do:**

* **Validation Program Planning and Execution:** Develop and own integrated validation program plans covering both new product introduction and retrofits or engineering changes to existing parts — qualification sequence, entry and exit criteria, material and laboratory dependencies, and decision gates — holding the critical path and driving programs to documented closure.
* **Inside Plant and Outside Plant Infrastructure:** Manage ISP structured cabling across backbone and horizontal distribution, riser and plenum pathways, main and intermediate distribution frames (MDF/IDF), cabinet and rack-mounted patch fields, fiber distribution frames, splice and termination enclosures, cassette-based modular patching, cable tray, basket and innerduct pathway, and firestopping and pathway segregation; and OSP placement across duct bank and conduit, microduct and air-blown fiber, maintenance holes and handholes, aerial and direct-buried routes, building entrance facilities and points of entry (MPOE), transition splice points, armored and dielectric constructions, and environmental and ingress protection at the ISP/OSP demarcation.
* **Fiber Cable, Connectivity, and Termination Scope:** Qualify single-mode (OS2, 9/125 µm) and multimode cable across the full range of standard counts in general industry use, from 24-fiber distribution cable through 3456-fiber high-count backbone, in loose tube, central core, ribbon, rollable ribbon, and 200/250 µm coating designs, evaluating diameter, bend radius, pulling tension, duct fill, and mid-span access against pathway and installation constraints. Own connectivity across LC and LC duplex, MTP/MPO single-row and dual-row arrays (8, 12, 16, and 24 fiber), and very-high-density MMC arrays (16 and 24 fiber), including pinned (male) and unpinned (female) configurations, UPC and APC endface geometries, gender and key orientation, and polarity schemes spanning TIA-568 Method A, B, and C and the conventions applicable to multi-row arrays. Define and validate patch panel, cassette, adapter plate, and shelf configurations for port density, fiber management, bend radius protection, slack storage, labeling access, and serviceability, and evaluate breakout, fanout, harness, trunk, and pigtail assemblies against port mapping and channel performance requirements.
* **Test, Measurement, and Acceptance:** Establish and govern optical test programs — Tier 1 optical loss test set (OLTS) insertion loss and return loss certification, Tier 2 OTDR characterization, bidirectional testing, length and continuity verification, polarity and fitment verification, and endface inspection and cleaning to recognized criteria such as IEC 61300-3-35 — controlling test reference cord (TRC) grade, referencing method, and calibration state so results are repeatable and defensible. Reconcile measured channel performance against design acceptance criteria and transceiver link specifications, and drive corrective action where acceptance limits are not met.
* **Supplier Qualification and Test Equipment Capability:** Lead technical qualification of cable, connectivity, and pathway manufacturers through sample submission, first-article inspection, mechanical and optical evaluation, failure analysis, root cause determination, and corrective action closure, maintaining a defensible qualification record and a clear statement of remaining gaps per supplier. Evaluate, select, and introduce fiber test and inspection platforms end to end, covering technical evaluation against requirements, procurement support, asset control and inventory, calibration and reference cord management, operator training, and fleet distribution to regional field crews.
* **Documentation and Standards:** Produce and sustain installation work instructions, test procedures, golden samples, first-of-kind build documentation, labeling and administration schemes, and as-built records, maintaining them so methods are applied consistently by field crews and subcontractors without procedural drift.
* **Program Governance and Risk Management:** Maintain accurate program status, ownership, target dates, and documented reasons for schedule movement, and produce recurring technical status reporting for client and internal leadership, surfacing aging, blocked, and unassigned work rather than allowing it to persist. Identify technical, schedule, supply chain, and capability risks in advance, quantify impact, drive mitigation to a named owner and committed date, and escalate with a recommendation.
* **Safety and Regulatory Compliance:** Champion a zero-injury culture in laboratory and field environments, ensuring personnel and subcontractors understand and apply laser safety, confined space, excavation, aerial work, and fiber handling requirements, and that work complies with OSHA and other applicable regulations and site access requirements.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Knowledge and use of basic telecom hand tools.
* Must understand customer service.
* Cleared understanding of job safety requirements.
* Should be familiar on wiring schemes and wiring test.
* Reports to Operations Manager and take daily directions from Technician, Technician II, Lead Technicians, Senior Technicians and Advance Senior Technicians.

* Performing all types of copper field terminations
* Install ladder racking and seismic bracing
* Patch network equipment
* Read and Understand Port Maps/Matrices
* Read and understand job floor plan and TC drawings
* Should understand and be capable in performing field terminations and labeling.
* Install Copper and Fiber Cabling and labeling
* Affixing Labels to cabling and Power Cords
* Affix bar coding to equipment

* Cut and install fiber trough

* Understand the basics of "FIM" and operate scanner

* Install pull strings through conduits, in ceilings

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1762450

Location: Anywhere in Country

  

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

  

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  

EY's Cloud Infrastructure team is seeking a Senior Manager, Cloud Platform Architect to help clients build the cloud platforms that their AI and data strategies depend on. Many large organizations want to run large language models (LLMs) and AI agents in production but lack a secure, well-governed cloud platform to support them. In this role, you will design that platform, lead the teams that build it, and advise the senior executives who sponsor it.

  

**The opportunity**

As a Senior Manager, Cloud Platform Architect, you will set the architecture direction for enterprise public cloud environments on Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Google Cloud. You will lead blended onshore, nearshore, and offshore teams and serve as design authority on complex, multi-workstream programs. Clients will rely on you for decisions on cloud strategy, landing zones, networking, identity and security, migration and modernization, and cost management, as well as the guardrails that allow them to run LLMs and agents securely and cost-effectively. You will draw on container platforms, automation, and DevOps practices where they fit the client's needs.

  

You will also connect the platform to enterprise knowledge by building infrastructure for structured, graph, vector, and keyword retrieval, GraphRAG, and agent context, so that AI applications draw on trusted, permission-aware data. You will work with client chief information officers, chief technology officers, and data and AI leaders, and you will remain technical enough to review designs and challenge architecture decisions.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

**Pursuits, delivery, and stakeholder management**

* Lead complex, multi-workstream cloud platform programs, managing scope, staffing, and status reporting, and reporting on outcomes such as delivery progress, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Lead strategic pursuits, including solution approach, estimates, statement of work inputs, and executive presentations, as well as working sessions, architecture reviews, and steering committee updates.
* Build trusted relationships with senior client technology, data, AI, and business leaders, and with our cloud and software partners.

**Public cloud architecture**

* Architect enterprise solutions across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, spanning compute, storage, networking, identity, data, and security services, and advise clients on the right services for each workload.
* Design multi-cloud and hybrid strategies and define target-state architectures and roadmaps, including landing zones, account and subscription structure, connectivity, multi-region topology, and governance, in line with each provider's well-architected framework.
* Lead cloud migration and modernization efforts, including workload assessments, migration patterns, and target-state designs.
* Establish cloud security, identity, and compliance guardrails, along with financial operations (FinOps) practices that give clients cost visibility and optimization.
* Guide resilience, disaster recovery, and performance decisions, and stay current on new services and pricing models from each provider.
* Advise clients on cloud and data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric) and translate emerging capabilities into practical enterprise solutions.

**Platform strategy and architecture**

* Own architecture principles and major design decisions, and serve as design authority across programs.
* Design platform architectures that balance enterprise standards with team autonomy.
* Conduct maturity assessments and gap analyses, and guide clients toward a platform-as-a-product model with developer self-service where appropriate.
* Set standards for infrastructure as code and automation (e.g., Terraform/OpenTofu, CI/CD) and for software supply-chain security.
* Establish observability and reliability practices using cloud-native and open-source tooling (Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Cloud Monitoring, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog), including service-level objectives, alerting, and incident reviews.
* Develop reusable EY methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and delivery assets.

**AI-ready and knowledge-grounded platforms**

* Architect platforms that run LLMs and AI cloud services (e.g., AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI), with guardrails for data boundaries, outbound network traffic, and AI agent identity, aligned to client security and compliance requirements.
* Design infrastructure for structured, graph, vector, and keyword retrieval, and guide GraphRAG and agent-context architectures that preserve lineage, provenance, and access controls, so that AI applications receive trusted, permission-aware context.

**Talent development**

* Hire, coach, and mentor engineers and architects, and contribute to technical recruiting.
* Build EY's community of practice and lead internal enablement on public cloud architecture, platform engineering, and AI-native engineering.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

To thrive in this role, you will need a combination of technical depth, business acumen, client leadership, and delivery excellence. Your skills will include:

* Executive presence and strong systems-thinking skills, with the ability to connect cloud platform architecture to business and AI outcomes and to engage technology, data, risk, security, and AI leaders.
* A player-coach approach, leading complex programs while remaining hands-on in design and review.
* Ability to explain architecture trade-offs and recommendations in clear business terms to executive and technical audiences.
* Demonstrated leadership across multiple workstreams and multidisciplinary teams.
* Strong consulting, pursuit, and relationship-management skills, with experience shaping cloud and AI platform strategies for large organizations.
* Ability to balance innovation with governance, security, scalability, and operational readiness.
* Team-first leadership that builds trust, accountability, and a culture of continuous improvement, and develops high-performing teams across architecture, engineering, governance, and AI.
* A commitment to building trusted, scalable platforms that give enterprise AI a strong foundation.

Title: Engineering Manager - Grafana Infrastructure (Remote, USA)
Description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

*This is a remote position and we're considering candidates in the US or Canada (residents of Québec are not eligible for this position).*

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

### **About our platform**

Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves it to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it efficiently and securely.

The Foundations department owns the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP): the Kubernetes clusters, cloud service provider resources (CSP), hardware, identity, delivery, and observability systems that Grafana Labs's application engineers use to build, deploy, and run their workloads.

### **About the Infrastructure group**

We're hiring an engineering manager for the Foundations Infrastructure group, which owns the cloud infrastructure Grafana Cloud runs on. The group provisions and operates Kubernetes clusters and CSP resources across GCP, AWS, and Azure; enforces identity, access, and security controls across those environments; and runs the observability and cost-visibility systems that keep the infrastructure measurable and accountable.

You'll lead one of the squads of platform engineers that comprise the group.

We're platform engineers, and our application teams are our users. Our job is to give them leverage: self-service building blocks that take care of the hard parts of infrastructure, so they can focus on what they're building. We treat the platform as a product and value the experience of the people who use it. When a change is well communicated and understood, teams welcome it, and it lands as an improvement that makes the right way the easy way. You'll lead a squad that makes that happen.

### **How we work**

Foundations is a global team that works asynchronously. The people who own a component or problem make the decisions about it, once stakeholders have had a chance to weigh in. Application teams build and run their own services; we give them a self-service platform to do it on.

Every engineer is on-call for the components their squad provides. We plan on-call, tactical work, and time off into every quarter, so roadmap work is roughly half of an engineer's time rather than all of it.

**What You'll Be Doing**
------------------------

* Hire, manage, and develop a squad of platform engineers, with regular feedback and career conversations that support each person's growth.
* Own your squad's roadmap and quarterly objectives: help decide what the squad works on, what it defers, and why, across a broad remit where demand always exceeds capacity.
* Take platform changes from design to fleet-wide adoption: staged rollouts, migration paths, and clear communication, so changes land well for the teams who depend on them.
* Partner with the other Infrastructure squads on work that spans them, and with the teams across Foundations and the rest of Engineering whose work depends on yours.
* Help shape how the group works as a whole, including planning, on-call, and the ownership model between squads.
* Own the squad's intake. Requests, reviews, and support from application teams arrive continuously; keep them triaged and visible so that planned work still moves.
* Keep on-call healthy: ensure a sustainable load and support incident response.
* Work across team boundaries, contributing beyond your squad's scope where Foundations needs it.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.

We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always paired with strong code review and quality standards.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**
------------------------------

* Experience managing engineers, ideally a team that builds and operates production CSP infrastructure, security, networking and/or storage
* Hands-on depth in at least one area of platform engineering, such as cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes, infrastructure security and access, or observability. You can challenge a design in your area on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.
* Fluency with infrastructure as code and with running Kubernetes in production.
* A track record of landing internal engineering/developer platform changes at scale. You've driven a migration or a rollout across many teams or many clusters, and you know what makes one stall.
* The ability to explain platform engineering to very different audiences (platform engineers, application teams, product management and business leadership) and to make the case for what the squad should and shouldn't take on.
* Be comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures in a fully remote environment, using clear, written communication to build trust and psychological safety.
* You're a motivated self-starter with a strong bias toward action and ownership, able to navigate ambiguity in a complex problem space.
* Comfort with AI-assisted tooling. We embrace AI and agentic development, so we expect you to be curious and comfortable using AI-powered tools, and ideally to have practical experience folding them into a team's workflow.

**Bonus Points For**
--------------------

* Experience across more than one of the group's areas: cloud infrastructure, infrastructure security, and observability
* Hands-on depth in cloud infrastructure security: cloud IAM, Kubernetes security, secrets, and workload identity on at least one major cloud provider. You can challenge a threat model or an access design on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.
* Building self-service infrastructure for application teams
* Running observability for a production platform at scale
* Operating across more than one of GCP, AWS, and Azure
* You've worked in or on open source, or other community-based projects. At Grafana Labs, "OSS is in our DNA"

In the USA, the base compensation range for this role is $189,374 - $227,249. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

**Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:**

* **100% Remote, Global Culture -** As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
* **Scaling Organization** – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
